Validation Rules: TAVI CRM + Desk vs Zoho

Every result from the runs of 12 and 13 November 2026 (all 174 cases). Rules were tested on CRM Leads and Desk Tickets on NDC-Staging, and compared live with the Zoho CRM and Zoho Desk test orgs. Nothing has been filed in Plane.

Main pointRules work: they block and warn on create, edit, inline edit, mass update, API and import, in both apps. The old "rules never apply" problem is fixed.
Bugs13 found (6 new on 13 Nov). The serious ones: blueprint steps that skip rules, a user blocked by a rule on a field they can't edit or see, two admins overwriting each other, and rules left Active but broken after a field, layout or department is deleted.
Zoho parityOnly one gap left (function code inside the product). Four items from the intake gap list are now built.
Still openEvery case has a result now. 8 are still blocked: Help Center CAPTCHA, web forms and Kanban broken on staging, no mobile app, and a profile permission change my safety check refuses.

Bugs found (13)

Severity is my suggestion. Click a screenshot to enlarge it.

I1

Two admins edit the same rule: the second save silently wipes the first

High

CRM (editor is shared with Desk) · Case: Two admins edit the same rule · Saving, conflicts and limits

Test
Open the rule in 2 tabs; save tab 1, then tab 2.
What happened
Tab A and tab B open the same rule. B saves "changed in tab 2". A, still showing the old copy, saves "changed in tab 1". A's save is accepted with no message and B's change is gone. The server already knows how to refuse this (an old version returns 409 "This validation rule was changed by someone else"), but the editor does not send the version, so the check never runs.
Expected
The second save is refused with "changed by someone else, reload", like the API does when it gets the version.
J7

Old Desk rule shows the wrong warning and is still enforced

Medium

Desk · Case: Old rule with no layout · Changes after the fact

Test
The 3 Nov "QA NDC Reject needs a reason" rule has no layout and the API says "A Desk validation rule applies to one layout; choose it." Check it on a ticket.
What happened
The existing rule "QA NDC Reject needs a reason" (no layout) is marked in the list and the editor as "This rule can't be applied (a field it uses changed or was deleted)". The real cause is the missing layout (the editor opens with Layout empty). The warning also says the rule can't be applied, but the server still applies it: a ticket set to "QA NDC Reject" with no reason is refused with "Please add a clear rejection reason".
Expected
The warning names the real cause (no layout) and matches what the server does: either the rule runs and no warning says it can't, or it really stops running.
J2

A field used in a rule's "Applies when" can be deleted, leaving the rule broken but Active

Medium

CRM + Desk · Case: Delete a field used in "Applies when" · Changes after the fact

Test
Delete the other field.
What happened
Deleting the field that a rule uses only in "Applies when" is accepted (204) with no warning. The rule stays Active with the hidden error "'qa_vr_j2' is not a field of this module" and stops doing its job; records save freely. The field the rule checks is protected (FIELD_IN_USE_BY_RULE), so only this part is missing.
Expected
The delete is refused (or warns) the same way it does for the checked field, or the rule is switched off and flagged.

API check, no screenshot. Full response text is in the case notes below.

G14

A value typed into a blueprint transition form skips validation rules

new, 13 NovHigh

CRM · Case: Blueprint transition · Where rules run

Test
Transition form asks for the checked field; enter a bad value. Then an after-transition field update to a bad value.
What happened
QA blueprint on the test layout: the transition "QA to Reject" asks for the text field. An active rule refuses text starting with BAD. On the lead page the user clicks "QA to Reject", types BAD-bp and clicks Execute. The transition succeeds (200) and the lead now holds BAD-bp. No check runs in the form or on the server. The after-transition field update also writes past a rule, which matches Zoho.
Expected
The transition is refused with the rule message, the same as a normal save.
G18

A value typed into a ticket blueprint step skips validation rules

new, 13 NovHigh

Desk · Case: Ticket pipeline / stage fields · Where rules run

Test
Change ticket status/stage where the stage form asks for the checked field.
What happened
Same QA blueprint on a Desk ticket. The agent clicks "QA to Reject", types BAD-bp and clicks Run. No field check runs, the transition succeeds (200) and the ticket moves to Reject with BAD-bp saved.

J6

Deleting a layout leaves its rules listed and Active

Medium

CRM + Desk · Case: Delete the layout · Changes after the fact

Test
Delete a layout that has rules.
What happened
A layout that has an active rule can be deleted (204). The rule stays in the list and stays Active, pointing to a layout that no longer exists (hidden error "Layout … is not a layout of this module").
Expected
The layout delete warns about the rules, and the rules are removed or switched off and clearly flagged.

API check, no screenshot. Full response text is in the case notes below.

H6

A user is blocked by a rule on a field they are not allowed to change

new, 13 NovHigh

CRM + Desk (Desk checked with a Desk Agent) · Case: Field read-only for the user's profile · Several rules together

Test
Make the checked field read-only for a profile; that user saves a record with a bad old value.
What happened
Rule "note must not be empty". The note field is set to read-only for the profile User. A CRM User creates a lead: they cannot type in the note, and the save is refused with "QA H6 note is required". The user has no way to save. The owner is still blocked, which is correct.
Expected
The rule does not block a user on a field they cannot change. Zoho CRM skips a rule when the field is read-only for the profile.

API check, no screenshot. Full response text is in the case notes below.

H7

A user is blocked by a rule on a field that is hidden from them

new, 13 NovHigh

CRM + Desk · Case: Field hidden by field permissions · Several rules together

Test
Field hidden for the profile; rule on it.
What happened
Same rule, with the note field hidden for the profile User (the effective permissions say hidden). The CRM User saves and is refused with "QA H6 note is required" for a field they cannot even see.
Expected
The rule does not run for users who cannot see the field; it still runs for everyone else.

API check, no screenshot. Full response text is in the case notes below.

C7

Deleted department shows as a raw id and the rule gives no warning

new, 13 NovMedium

Desk · Case: Deleted department in the picker · Create and edit a rule

Test
Rule for a department that is then deleted (or moved to trash).
What happened
A rule for "QA VR1112 C7 dept" + Customer Support. The department is then deleted. The rule stays Active with no warning. The rules list shows "d2a27f92-6a33-… , Customer Support" instead of "(deleted department)". The editor shows only Customer Support ticked and gives no sign of the deleted one; Save keeps the deleted id.

M4

Screen readers are not told why a save was refused

new, 13 NovMedium

CRM + Desk · Case: Screen reader · Language, RTL and accessibility

Test
Refused save with a screen reader.
What happened
When a save is refused, the message appears under the field, but the input has no aria-invalid, no aria-describedby pointing at the message, and there is no role="alert" or live region. On CRM focus moves to the bad field; on Desk focus goes to Subject instead.
Expected
The field is marked invalid, the message is linked to it and announced, and focus goes to the refused field.
E2

A message set to show "at the top of the form" is not brought into view

Medium

CRM · Case: Message at the top of the form · What the user sees when a rule breaks

Test
Same rule with "At the top of the form".
What happened
With "Show the error: at the top of the form", the message is drawn at the top, but Save does not scroll to it and the field is not marked. A user who is lower down the form presses Save and sees nothing happen.
Expected
The page scrolls to the message (or the field is also marked), so the user sees why the save failed. Zoho shows the alert where the user can see it.
B2

Rules list shows the raw layout id instead of the layout name

Low

CRM · Case: List columns and badges · Rules list

Test
Create a block rule, a warn rule, a function rule (CRM), a field-verification rule (CRM) and a Help Center rule (Desk).
What happened
On a fresh page load the CRM rules list shows "9f0069ec-a4a0-4f50-…" in the Layout column instead of "QA VR1112 Layout". Seen twice, in English and Arabic. The name appears only after a save in the same page. The Desk list shows names correctly.

The Layout column always shows the layout name.
K3

Deleting a rule through another module's address says "deleted" but deletes nothing

Low

CRM + Desk · Case: Other tenant's rule id · Security and API contract

Test
GET / PUT / DELETE a rule id with a different module id, and a made-up id.
What happened
DELETE /modules/{other module}/validation-rules/{id} answers 204. The rule is still there afterwards (GET on the right module 200). GET through the wrong module correctly answers 404.

Worth discussing

Marked Info in the sheet. Each could be a bug or a design choice. Your call before anything is filed.

  • F10
    Possible security risk. Function rule URLs that point inside the network are accepted at save: https://localhost, 127.0.0.1, 169.254.169.254 (cloud metadata), 10.0.0.5 and [::1] all returned 201. I could not prove the server then calls them (no receiver). Ask the developers whether calls to private addresses are refused.
  • G13
    Workflow updates skip rules. A workflow field update on create wrote qa_vr_text = "BAD-from-workflow" and the record saved, although the rule refuses that value. Zoho also lets workflow field updates through, so this may be by design; decide if TAVI should match.
  • J3
    Rule silently stops working. Removing the checked field from the rule's layout is allowed and the rule stays Active with no warning. It now has nothing to check on that layout.
  • J4
    Pick-list value removed. Removing the pick-list value "No" that an active rule compares to is allowed. The rule stays Active with the hidden error "'No' is not one of the options". Same family as J2.
  • C15
    Conditions reset with no prompt. Changing "Field to check" after adding conditions keeps the conditions but switches them to the new field, resets the operator to "is empty" and drops the values, with no prompt. An admin who doesn't notice gets a rule that blocks every record with an empty value (this happened during the run in I2).
  • G22
    Merge skips rules. Merging two records (CRM) or tickets (Desk) and keeping the value from the duplicate writes "BAD-dup" into the master, although an active rule refuses it (merge 200 on both apps). Zoho behaviour is not documented.
  • B9
    Warnings banner never appears. The editor has a "saved, with warnings" banner, but the server returned no warnings for every case tried, including a rule on a layout that does not have the field. The banner was never shown.
  • N3
    Slow rule creation on CRM. Creating 60 rules took about 2 seconds each on CRM (128 s), against 0.3 s each on Desk. The list itself stays fast (search 12 ms).
  • F9
    Function call details. Checked with a live webhook.site receiver: the call carries the record values, record id on edit and a correct HMAC-SHA256 signature, and no user token. The layout id is not sent, and the signature has no timestamp, so a captured request could be replayed.
  • X2
    Warning confirmations not in the audit log. The warn flow works, but the audit log records only "record created", not that the user saw and confirmed a warning.
  • C17
    Duplicate rule names. Two rules with the same name are both saved (201) on CRM and Desk. The Zoho rule on names is not documented; decide if TAVI should refuse.

Different from Zoho

  • D20
    Several failing conditions. TAVI stops at the first condition whose "Applies when" matches; the editor says so. Zoho CRM (checked live) fires every failing condition and shows all alerts.
  • G3
    Editing an old record that already breaks a new rule. TAVI allows a save that changes another field and refuses only when the checked field changes. Zoho CRM (live) refuses the save even when only another field (Title) changes.
  • G13
    Workflow field update. Writes a value that breaks a rule and the record saves (see above).
  • H6 / Z11
    Field read-only or hidden for the user. Zoho CRM skips a rule when the field is read-only for the profile. TAVI still runs it and blocks the user (bugs H6, H7).
  • Z10
    Removing the checked field from a Desk layout. Zoho Desk asks, then switches the rule off. TAVI allows it with no prompt and the rule stays Active (J3).
  • Z13 / D26
    Relative dates. Zoho Desk accepts ${CURRENTTIME} in date rules. TAVI takes only fixed dates (API refuses today / ${CURRENTTIME}). Zoho CRM has no relative dates either.
  • G7
    Lead convert. Same as Zoho: converting a lead runs the rules of the target module (refused with the Contacts rule message).
  • D1
    Text "is" and case. Same as Zoho: "is" ignores upper and lower case.
  • D14
    Pattern rules and empty fields. TAVI "does not match the pattern" fires on an empty optional field, so the admin must add "Applies when … is not empty". Zoho CRM has no pattern check, and its "does not contain" does not fire on an empty field.

Where TAVI is stronger

  • Z9
    A field a rule checks can't be deleted (FIELD_IN_USE_BY_RULE). Zoho deletes the field and the rule with it.
  • Z7
    API and import saves always run the rules. In Zoho CRM the API runs them only when the caller opts in; a plain API insert with a bad value succeeds (checked live).
  • Z5
    Mass update runs the rule on every record. Zoho hides fields with rules from mass update (checked live).
  • I5 / I6 / Z14
    Bigger limits: 25 conditions per rule (Zoho 10) and 1000-character messages (Zoho 100). Names up to 200 characters.
  • Z1–Z4
    The intake listed lookup, checkbox, owner and Status fields as missing. They are built now: the CRM and Desk editors offer them and the server enforces them.
  • Extras
    Regex checks in CRM, English + Arabic message per condition, warn-and-let-the-user-decide, "trigger when it does not match", All-layouts rules, a full rules API, a Test button for function rules and a signing secret. These are pluses, not bugs.

Gap left vs Zoho (1)

  • Z8
    Function code inside the product. Zoho CRM lets you write the check as a Deluge function inside Zoho. TAVI calls an outside HTTPS address you host. The result is the same, but the customer needs their own server.

Blocked (8)

  • A7
    Grant the permission to a profile. Needs a short change to the shared User profile permissions; refused by my safety check, needs your OK or a manual test.
  • G6
    Kanban move. Retried 13 Nov: the Leads Kanban still shows "Could not load these records"; each column's records call returns 500. Looks like its own bug.
  • G12
    Web form. Built a QA web form with CAPTCHA off, but the public form API returns 404 for every form on staging (the existing Desk form too). Looks like a regression of NDC-2732.
  • G15
    Help Center ticket form, switch on. Help Center form needs a CAPTCHA. Manual check needed (steps are in the case notes).
  • G16
    Help Center ticket form, switch off. Help Center CAPTCHA, as G15.
  • X4
    Customer on the Help Center. Help Center CAPTCHA, as G15.
  • Z6
    Web form records go to approval. Depends on G12.
  • Z15
    Mobile apps run rules. No TAVI mobile app.

Cleanup

  • TAVI
    All QA VR1112 test data from both runs is removed: rules, layout rules, test fields, both test layouts, the Desk contacts, the test department, imported and converted records. Every deleted test record was then purged from the Recycle Bin by exact record id (about 190 items, all named QA VR1112 or created by our own lead convert).
  • Left
    One test lead "QA VR1112 G14" (id 39145329…) can't be deleted: TAVI says it is "under review" (an approval process picked it up). It needs the review closed, then delete. Profile User permissions were not changed (A7).
  • NDC
    The existing rule "QA NDC Reject needs a reason" was not changed.
  • Zoho
    Everything created in the test orgs was deleted. One deleted CRM field may still show in Zoho's deleted-fields list.
